title: Citation Integrity Verdict
description: DISCOVER-stage hard-gate artifact. Output of citation-integrity-auditor. Derived mechanically from citation_checker.py over claim_list + claim_evidence_map. BLOCKs when: (1) a claim has no valid locus, (2) a locus has support_relation='contradicts' with supports_claim=false (the linker read reported_result and judged the locus a genuine refutation — the ONE per-locus hard BLOCK), (3) a ref is unresolvable, or (4) a claim ends up with no genuinely supporting locus at all. D9 (2026-08-06): a supports_claim=false locus whose support_relation is 'insufficient' is UNVERIFIED — the source was unreachable/paywalled/silent — not contradicted; it is listed in unverified_loci. R3 A1 (2026-08-07) widens the same 'boundary is not a refutation' principle to support_relation='partial' (a scope qualification, listed in bounded_loci) and to a missing supports_claim or an unrecognised support_relation (listed in undecided_loci, replacing the old conservative BLOCK-on-missing). None of these three tolerated states blocks on its own; the claim survives only if some locus is a genuine support. There is NO automatic numeric comparison — contradiction detection is the linker's explicit supports_claim decision, enforced deterministically by the gate. verdict BLOCK halts the DISCOVER stage.

unresolvable_refs.description: refs that could not be resolved to a real source

no_locus_claims.description: claim_ids that have no mapping in the claim_evidence_map or have only empty loci

contradicted_claims.description: claim_ids where a locus genuinely contradicts the claim: support_relation='contradicts' with supports_claim=false. R3 A1 (2026-08-07): a missing supports_claim no longer lands here (see undecided_loci), and support_relation='partial' never did (see bounded_loci) — a boundary or an undecided locus is not a refutation.

unverified_loci.description: D9. '<claim_id>:<locus_id>' for every locus the linker marked supports_claim=false with support_relation='insufficient' — the source could not be opened or does not address the point. These do not block on their own, so they are listed here to keep a partially-covered PASS from reading as fully verified.

bounded_loci.description: R3 A1 (2026-08-07). '<claim_id>:<locus_id>' for every locus the linker marked supports_claim=false with support_relation='partial' — the locus narrows or qualifies the claim's scope rather than refuting it. Non-blocking on its own; listed so a claim that survives on a narrower locus is never silently read as fully entailed.

undecided_loci.description: R3 A1 (2026-08-07). '<claim_id>:<locus_id>' for every locus where the linker omitted supports_claim, or used a support_relation this gate does not recognise. Replaces the old conservative BLOCK-on-missing (Mechanism 2) with a visible, non-blocking flag.
